chrome-win-trace.description: Calls Chrome for Testing 157.0.8103.38 (win64) made on real Windows, recorded with the API tracer (specs/windows/apps/chrome)

macos-objc-api.description: Objective-C classes, protocols, methods and properties of the macOS SDK frameworks, by name, from clang -extract-api symbol graphs of the public headers (ADR 0187)

macos-sdk.description: macOS SDK .tbd stubs (exported symbols and Objective-C classes)

macos-swift-interface.description: Public Swift API of the macOS SDK modules, by name, from the .swiftinterface files (ADR 0187)

ms-learn-chrome-net.description: Microsoft Learn Winsock, I/O completion port, overlapped I/O, named pipe and thread pool wait reference, and the observed call trace of Chrome for Testing's network service on Windows (names, counts and first-call order): what Chrome's network stack does per page load, observed by the spec agent spec-win-chrome-setup

ms-learn-commctrl.description: Microsoft Learn common controls reference and the public SDK header commctrl.h: the window classes of comctl32 and their messages and notifications (entries named by class, version 5.82)

ms-learn-d3d11.description: Microsoft Learn Direct3D 11, DXGI and DirectComposition reference and the public SDK headers d3d11*.h, dxgi*.h, dcomp.h, dxcore*.h: the COM interfaces and methods of d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll, dcomp.dll (entries named Interface.Method)

ms-learn-dwrite.description: Microsoft Learn DirectWrite reference and the public SDK headers dwrite.h .. dwrite_3.h: the COM interfaces and methods of dwrite.dll (entries named Interface.Method)

ms-learn-eventlog.description: Microsoft Learn event logging reference (event sources, EVENTLOGRECORD, the EventLog registry keys) as Chrome's setup.exe uses it, observed by the spec agents (spec-win-chrome-setup); entries named by behaviour

ms-learn-input-idle.description: Microsoft Learn WaitForInputIdle, ShellExecuteEx (SEE_MASK_WAITFORINPUTIDLE) and the message-queue functions that make a process 'idle for input': what the oracle does for console and GUI processes (entries named by function, the ShellExecuteEx mask by dotted name)

ms-learn-netfw.description: Microsoft Learn Windows Firewall with Advanced Security API (netfw.h: INetFwPolicy2, INetFwRules, INetFwRule) as Chrome's setup.exe uses it to add its inbound mDNS rule, observed by the spec agents (spec-win-chrome-setup); entries named by class

ms-learn-setup-files.description: Microsoft Learn file, process and snapshot reference (winbase.h, fileapi.h, tlhelp32.h) for what Chrome's own setup.exe calls, observed by the spec agent spec-win-chrome-setup (docs/windows/chrome-setup-plan.md); entries named by function or behaviour

ms-learn-shell-download.description: Microsoft Learn and the public SDK headers shobjidl_core.h, shellapi.h, shlobj_core.h, fileapi.h, winbase.h: the COM interfaces and methods Chrome's download path uses in shell32.dll, comdlg32.dll (entries named Interface.Method) and the kernel32.dll functions beside them

ms-learn-shell-link.description: Microsoft Learn and the public SDK headers shobjidl_core.h, shlobj_core.h, propsys.h, propvarutil.h, objidl.h and the Microsoft format specification MS-SHLLINK: shell links (CLSID_ShellLink, IShellLinkW/A, IPersistFile, IPropertyStore on a link, the .lnk file) as Chrome's setup.exe uses them; entries named Interface or Class.Interface (spec-win-chrome-setup, docs/windows/chrome-installer-plan.md)

ms-learn-systemtemp.description: Microsoft Learn file system and temporary file reference: the C:\Windows\SystemTemp directory that installers extract into, observed by the spec agents (spec-win-elevation); entries named by directory

ms-learn-taskschd.description: Microsoft Learn Task Scheduler 2.0 reference and the public SDK headers taskschd.h, winerror.h: the COM interfaces of taskschd.dll (entries named Interface.Method, and Interface.Property for a get/put pair; spec-win-taskschd)

ms-learn-uac.description: User Account Control: Microsoft Learn (Access Tokens, Mandatory Integrity Control, ShellExecuteEx, Application Manifests) and the oracle's behaviour for the split token of an administrator: the standard (filtered) token and the elevated (full) token (entries named by the behaviour; docs/windows/chrome-installer-plan.md)

ms-learn-volume.description: Microsoft Learn volume management and CreateFile reference (opening a volume as \\.\C: or \??\C:), observed by the spec agents (spec-win-elevation); entries named by operation

ms-learn-winuser.description: Microsoft Learn window messages and system commands of user32 (winuser.h): behaviour that is not an export, entries named by message or command (WM_NCHITTEST, WM_ENTERSIZEMOVE, WM_MOUSEHWHEEL, SC_MAXIMIZE; spec-win-input)

poly-adr-0132.description: Kernel interfaces that Linux package formats need (ADR 0132): squashfs, loop, fuse, overlayfs, namespaces, pivot_root, the new mount API, seccomp; entries named by the spec agents

windows-audio-w2.description: The COM audio interfaces of mmdevapi and audioses that Chrome for Windows calls for shared-mode output (device enumerator, devices, IAudioClient, render client, clock, session control), found by a COM-level trace of Chrome on the Windows oracle (spec-win-wasapi); names from Microsoft Learn, mmdeviceapi.h, audioclient.h and audiopolicy.h

windows-com-state.description: COM state of a thread and process observed by spec agents on the Windows oracle where Chrome's browser process reaches it (TEB.ReservedForOle, the global interface table, BITS); the names come from Microsoft Learn, objidl.h and bits.h (spec-com-ole-tls)

windows-export-probe.description: Exported names of Windows 11 system DLLs (kernelbase.dll, userenv.dll) found by spec agents on the oracle where Chrome's sandbox set-up reaches them; names only (spec-chrome-win-s2b)

windows-registry-defaults.description: What a Windows machine's registry holds by default in the 64-bit and the 32-bit view (HKLM\SOFTWARE and its Wow6432Node, the Classes roots, CurrentVersion, the standard COM interface, class and type-library registrations), read by test programs on the oracle; names and the small values the behaviour needs (spec-win-wow64-defaults, docs/windows/registry-defaults.md)

windows-stack-state.description: How the memory manager grows, guards and runs out a thread's stack (guard region, first touches below the committed pages, STATUS_STACK_OVERFLOW, SetThreadStackGuarantee, thread stack reservations), observed by spec agents on the Windows oracle where Chrome's decoder threads touch the stack; the names are ours, the facts come from Microsoft Learn (VirtualQuery, CreateThread, SetThreadStackGuarantee, ntstatus.h) and observation (spec-win-stack-roundrect)

windows-typelib-file.description: The binary type-library file (.tlb and the TYPELIB resource of an exe or dll) as ITypeLib and ITypeInfo read it, by black-box observation of files written with CreateTypeLib2 and of the updater's own libraries (docs/windows/typelib-file-format.md; spec-win-typelib-format)

wine.description: Wine conformance tests (wine-mirror/wine dlls/*/tests/*.c): the test functions that call an export, by name only; spec agents' oracle, never copied (CLEAN_ROOM.md, ADR 0097)
